evidence: Deposition of each film was performed at 300 °C using alternating surface-saturating reactions of ZrCl4/HfCl4 and H2O for ZrO2 and HfO2 depositions, respectively. Each precursor was pulsed for 2 s, followed by N2 for 30 and 60 s to remove the remnant precursors and byproducts after H2O and ZrCl4/HfCl4 pulsing.
